categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in communication system equipment and technology solutions, including core network systems, optical networks and access systems, intelligent networks and smart emergency systems, as well as technical and maintenance services. It serves both public communication networks (public networks) and industry-specific private networks (private networks).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as 5G core networks, IMS, RCS, UPF, XG(S)-PON, OTN-CPE, MSAN, and satellite core networks. It emphasizes virtualization, cloud-native architectures, AI intelligent scheduling, heterogeneous network integration, and full domestic production capabilities. Production mainly adopts an outsourcing model with strict quality control and in-house core processes like product design and testing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include telecom operators, government agencies, public utilities, energy, chemical, mining, and other industry clients requiring specialized communication networks. The company also targets emerging markets such as satellite internet, low-altitude economy, smart cities, smart mines, and emergency management sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively in China with significant domestic market presence and expanding international operations in Asia (Japan, Philippines, India, Bangladesh), the Middle East, and Africa. It has multiple wholly-owned and controlled subsidiaries in these regions to support local sales and technical services.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the communication equipment supply chain, focusing on R&D, product design, sales, and after-sales services. Manufacturing is largely outsourced to external factories, while the company retains control over core technology and quality management.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening 5G and F5G technology integration, expanding satellite internet core network capabilities, advancing 6G and NTN technologies, and developing next-generation optical access products like 50G PON. The company invests heavily in R&D for AIoT, network slicing, cloud-native core networks, and low-altitude communication solutions, aiming to maintain technological leadership and expand global market share.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of communication equipment and systems, complemented by technical and maintenance service contracts. The company also earns income from licensing, government subsidies, and investment returns. Sales are conducted primarily via direct sales channels to telecom operators and industry clients.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic communication system equipment and solutions provider with unique strengths in satellite internet core networks and full domestic production capabilities. It competes with large global players like Huawei, ZTE, Ericsson, and Nokia in public networks, while leveraging flexibility and customization to capture niche markets such as satellite communications and specialized private networks.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 951.7 million, a 7.6% increase year-over-year, and returned to profitability with a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 27.4 million. R&D investment accounted for over 20% of revenue, reflecting a strong commitment to innovation. The company’s total assets reached nearly RMB 1.95 billion, with steady growth in domestic and international markets.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes comprehensive end-to-end communication solutions with strong customization capabilities, advanced proprietary technologies, and full domestic production to ensure supply chain security. Its unique value lies in satellite 5G core network expertise, integration of cloud-native and AI technologies, and tailored solutions for specialized industries such as emergency management, smart mining, and low-altitude economy, enabling clients to achieve reliable, secure, and innovative communication services.
